info.name: Mad Perfume — Customer App API
info.description:
# Mad Perfume — Customer App API

Everything the mobile app needs. Requests are grouped by screen area; each one documents its body, query filters, pagination and possible statuses.

## Start here
1. Select the environment **Mad Perfume — Staging** (top right).
2. Run **Auth → Register** (or **Login**). The access and refresh tokens are saved automatically; every other request uses them.
3. Run **Catalog → Products**, then **Cart → Add to cart**, then **Orders → Place order**. Ids (`product_id`, `cart_item_id`, `order_id`, …) are captured automatically as you go.

## Conventions
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` is set at collection level; public endpoints override it to *No Auth*.
- **Tokens:** access lasts 60 min, refresh 30 days and **rotates** — always store both from the response. On `401`, call *Refresh token* once; if that fails too, sign the user out.
- **Pagination:** paginated endpoints return `{count, next, previous, results[]}` at 20 per page; use `?page=N`. Categories, banners, cart and rewards return plain arrays/objects.
- **Money:** strings with 2 decimals (`"160.00"`), USD. Tax is 8%, shipping is currently free.
- **Dates:** ISO 8601 UTC (`"2026-09-15T11:01:56Z"`); `estimated_delivery` is a plain date.
- **Errors:** `400` `{"field": ["message"]}` or `{"detail": "message"}`; `401` missing/expired token; `404` also means "belongs to another user"; `429` throttled (auth endpoints allow 10/min).

## Payments in one line
`POST /app/orders/` with `payment_method: "card"` → open Stripe PaymentSheet with the returned `client_secret` → poll `GET /app/orders/{id}/` until `status` is `"paid"`. Never mark an order paid from the app.

Full written guide: `docs/mobile-app-api.md` in the backend repo. Live schema: https://staging-api.bpmstudio.pt/api/docs/

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Register, login (email **or** phone), token refresh, logout and the 3-step password reset by emailed code.

request.description:
Create a customer account. Returns JWT tokens, so the user is signed in immediately.

**Body**
- `full_name` (required)
- `email` (required, unique)
- `phone` (required, unique)
- `password` (required) — min 8 chars, at least one number and one special character, not similar to name/email

**Responses**
- `201` `{access, refresh}` — saved automatically into the collection variables
- `400` `{"email": ["An account with this email already exists."]}`
- `400` `{"phone": [...]}, {"password": [...]}`
- `429` throttled (10/min)

Sign in with **email or phone**.

**Body**
- `identifier` — email address or phone number
- `password`

**Responses**
- `200` `{access, refresh}` — saved automatically
- `400` `{"detail": ["Invalid email/phone or password."]}`
- `429` throttled (10/min)

Exchange the refresh token for a new pair.

**Important:** refresh tokens rotate — the old one stops working, so always store both values from the response.

**Responses**
- `200` `{access, refresh}` — saved automatically
- `401` `{"detail": "Token is invalid or expired"}` → send the user to login

Blacklist the refresh token. Also call **Devices → Unregister device** so the phone stops receiving push.

**Responses**
- `200` `{}`
- `400` token already blacklisted/invalid

Emails a 6-digit code, valid **10 minutes**.

**Responses**
- `204` always, even for unknown emails (so nobody can discover which emails exist). Show "check your inbox" either way.
- `429` throttled (10/min)

Exchange the emailed code for a reset token.

**Responses**
- `200` `{uid, token}` — pass both to step 3 (saved automatically into `reset_uid` / `reset_token`)
- `400` `{"code": "Invalid or expired code."}` — the code locks after **5 wrong attempts**; request a new one

Sets the new password using `uid` + `token` from step 2.

**Responses**
- `204` done — all sessions are signed out, so send the user to login
- `400` `{"token": "This reset link is invalid or has expired."}`
- `400` `{"password": ["..."]}` password rules

item.name: 2. Profile & Devices
item.description: Profile, Settings toggles, Security (change password) and push device tokens.

request.description:
Profile + settings + points balance and tier. Use it to prefill Checkout and the Settings screens.

**Response `200`**
```json
{
  "id": 27, "full_name": "Sophia Laurent", "email": "sophia@example.com",
  "phone": "+33612345678", "shipping_address": "", "avatar_url": "", "language": "en",
  "push_enabled": true, "notify_collections": true, "notify_rewards": true, "notify_orders": true,
  "points_balance": 0, "tier": "silver"
}
```

Send **only the fields that change**.

**Editable:** `full_name`, `email`, `phone`, `shipping_address`, `language` (`en`|`ar`|`he`), `push_enabled`, `notify_collections`, `notify_rewards`, `notify_orders`.

This is what the Preference Center toggles and the Edit Profile screen save.

**Responses**
- `200` full profile
- `400` `{"phone": ["An account with this phone number already exists."]}`

**multipart/form-data** (do not set Content-Type by hand — Postman/the HTTP client sets the boundary).

Pick a file for the `avatar` key, then send.

**Responses**
- `200` full profile with the new `avatar_url` (hosted on Cloudinary)
- `400` `{"avatar": ["Image must be PNG, JPG or WebP."]}` or `["Image must be 10MB or smaller."]`

Security screen. 

**Responses**
- `204` changed — refresh tokens are revoked, so sign the user in again
- `400` `{"current_password": ["..."]}` wrong current password
- `400` `{"password": ["..."]}` rules not met

Call after login and whenever the FCM token changes. Re-sending the same token just moves it to this user.

**Body**
- `token` — FCM registration token
- `platform` — `ios` | `android`

**Responses**
- `201` `{token, platform}`

_Push delivery starts once Firebase credentials are configured on the backend; registering now is safe._

Call on logout. Set the `device_token` collection variable first.

**Responses**
- `204` removed
- `404` unknown token

item.name: 3. Catalog
item.description: Categories, home banners, products with search/filters/sorting, product detail, reviews and saved items.

request.description:
All collections, A→Z. **Public** (no token needed).

**Not paginated** — returns a plain array.

**Response `200`**
```json
[{"id": 7, "name": "Floral", "type": "classic",
  "description": "Light, blooming, romantic", "image_url": "https://res.cloudinary.com/…"}]
```

`type`: `classic` | `premium` | `exotic` | `seasonal` | `niche`

Banners that are live **today** (Home carousel). **Public**, not paginated.

**Response `200`**
```json
[{"id": 1, "title": "Summer Essence 2024", "image_url": "https://…",
  "starts_on": "2026-09-12", "ends_on": "2026-09-27"}]
```

query.description: Full-text over name, brand, notes, description, category
eau_de_parfum | eau_de_toilette | extrait_de_parfum | cologne | perfume_oil | home_fragrance

request.description:
Product listing. **Public**, but send the token when signed in so `is_saved` is correct.

**Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

**Enable the query params you need** (they are disabled by default in Postman):

| Param | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | `oud` | name, brand, scent notes, description, category |
| `category` | `7` | category id |
| `concentration` | `eau_de_parfum` | see enum below |
| `brand` | `MAD PERFUME` | case-insensitive exact |
| `min_price` / `max_price` | `100` / `250` | |
| `is_featured` | `true` | Featured Selection on Home |
| `ordering` | `-created_at` | `price`, `-price`, `-created_at` (new arrivals, default), `-sold` (best sellers), `-rating` |
| `page` | `2` | pagination |

`concentration`: `eau_de_parfum`, `eau_de_toilette`, `extrait_de_parfum`, `cologne`, `perfume_oil`, `home_fragrance`

**Item shape**
```json
{
  "id": 9, "name": "Alpine Mist", "brand": "MAD PERFUME",
  "category": 11, "category_name": "Musk", "concentration": "extrait_de_parfum",
  "size": "100ml", "notes": ["Oud", "Saffron"], "price": "160.00",
  "image_url": "https://…", "rating": 4.5, "reviews_count": 12,
  "is_saved": false, "in_stock": true
}
```

Everything on the Product Details screen. **Public**.

Same fields as the list item, plus:
- `description`
- `image_urls` — all images for the gallery
- `branches` — `[{id, name, city}]` for "Available at"

**Responses**
- `200` product
- `404` unknown id

Reviews for one product. **Public**.

**Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

**Item shape**
```json
{"id": 1, "user_name": "Sophia Laurent", "rating": 5,
 "comment": "A masterpiece of balance.", "created_at": "2026-09-15T11:01:56Z"}
```

The average and total are on the product itself (`rating`, `reviews_count`).

One review per product, and only for products in the user's **delivered** orders. Earns **+50 points**.

**Body**
- `rating` — 1..5 (required)
- `comment` — optional

**Responses**
- `201` the review
- `400` `{"detail": "You can review products from your delivered orders."}`
- `400` `{"detail": "You have already reviewed this product."}`
- `401` not signed in

The user's saved (wishlist) products. **Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

Items use the **same shape as the product list**, with `is_saved: true`.

Add to Saved Items (tapping the heart). Saving twice is harmless.

**Responses**
- `201` `{"product": 9}`
- `400` unknown product id

Note the path uses the **product id**, not a separate saved-item id.

**Responses**
- `204` removed
- `404` wasn't saved

item.name: 4. Boutiques
item.description: Branch locator: search, nearest-first, and branch detail.

query.description: Device latitude — use together with lng

request.description:
Boutique locator. **Public**.

**Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

**Query params**
| Param | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | `paris` | name, city, country, address |
| `lat` + `lng` | `48.86` / `2.33` | sorts nearest first; branches without coordinates are excluded |
| `page` | `2` | pagination |

Default order: flagship first, then by name.

**Item shape**
```json
{
  "id": 2, "name": "Paris Flagship", "is_flagship": true,
  "address": "75 Avenue des Champs-Élysées", "city": "Paris", "country": "France",
  "phone": "+33 1 45 61 98 01", "email": "paris@madperfume.com",
  "weekday_opens": "10:00:00", "weekday_closes": "21:00:00",
  "sunday_opens": "11:00:00", "sunday_closes": "19:00:00",
  "latitude": "48.871400", "longitude": "2.302000", "image_url": "https://…"
}
```

Branch Details screen. **Public**. Same object as a list item.

**Responses**
- `200` branch
- `404` unknown id

item.name: 5. Cart
item.description: Shopping bag: list, add (increments), change quantity, remove.

request.description:
The Shopping Bag. **Not paginated.**

**Response `200`**
```json
{
  "items": [{
    "id": 2, "product": 9, "name": "Alpine Mist",
    "category_name": "Musk",
    "variant": "100ml / Extrait de Parfum", "price": "160.00",
    "image_url": "https://…", "quantity": 1, "line_total": "160.00"
  }],
  "items_count": 1,
  "subtotal": "160.00"
}
```

- `category_name` is the small collection label above the name.
- `items_count` is the total quantity (for the tab badge).
- Tax and shipping are added at checkout, not here.

Adding a product that is already in the cart **increases** its quantity.

**Body**
- `product` — product id
- `quantity` — defaults to 1

**Responses**
- `201` the cart item
- `400` `{"quantity": ["Only 3 left in stock."]}` (checked against what's already in the cart)

Sets an absolute quantity (the − / + buttons).

**Responses**
- `200` the updated item with a new `line_total`
- `400` `{"quantity": ["Only 3 left in stock."]}`
- `404` item belongs to someone else / removed

REMOVE on a cart row.

**Responses**
- `204` removed
- `404` already gone

item.name: 6. Orders & Checkout
item.description: Checkout with Idempotency-Key, order history and order tracking.

header.description: One UUID per checkout attempt; reuse it on retries

request.description:
Turns the whole cart into an order, reserves stock and empties the cart.

### Headers
- `Idempotency-Key` — **required in the app** (Postman fills it with a random UUID per send). Generate ONE uuid when the user taps *Place order* and reuse it for every retry of that same attempt.

### Body
| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `shipping_name` | yes | |
| `shipping_address` | yes | |
| `shipping_city` | yes | |
| `shipping_phone` | no | falls back to the profile phone |
| `payment_method` | yes | `card` or `cod` |

### Responses
- `201` order created
- `200` **same `Idempotency-Key` sent again** → the same order, no duplicate
- `400` `{"detail": "Your cart is empty."}`
- `400` `{"detail": "Alpine Mist: only 1 left in stock."}`

`card` → `status: "pending_payment"` + `client_secret` for the Stripe sheet.
`cod` → `status: "processing"`, `client_secret: null`, invoice emailed right away.

The response includes `number`, `status`, `items[]` (with `variant` and scent `notes`), `events[]`, `subtotal`, `tax` (8%), `shipping_fee`, `total`, `estimated_delivery`, and the shipping fields.

The user's orders, newest first (Profile → Order History). **Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

Each item is the full order object (same as the detail), without `client_secret`.

Use `status` for the badge: `pending_payment`, `paid`, `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `cancelled`.

Order Tracking screen.

- `events[]` — the status timeline, **oldest first**: `[{"status": "pending_payment", "created_at": "…"}, {"status": "paid", …}]`
- `estimated_delivery` — date, e.g. `"2026-09-18"`
- `items[].notes` — scent tags, e.g. `["Oud", "Saffron"]`
- `card_last4` — for the Payment row

**Responses**
- `200` order
- `404` unknown id **or the order belongs to another user**

_Only the four status steps exist (Order Received → Processing → Shipped → Delivered). There is no courier "shipping journey" feed._

item.name: 7. Payments (reference)
item.description: How card payments complete. The Stripe webhook is server-to-server; the app only polls the order.

request.description:
**The app never calls this.** Stripe calls it server-to-server when a card payment succeeds; the backend then marks the order `paid` and emails the invoice.

It's here so you know how the order becomes `paid`:

1. App: `POST /app/orders/` with `payment_method: "card"` → `client_secret`
2. App: Stripe PaymentSheet with that `client_secret`
3. Stripe → backend: `payment_intent.succeeded`
4. App: poll `GET /app/orders/{id}/` until `status` is `paid`

Requests without a valid Stripe signature get `400` — that's expected if you send this from Postman.

item.name: 8. Loyalty & Rewards
item.description: Points summary, history with filters, rewards shop, redeeming and redeemed rewards.

request.description:
Everything on the Loyalty screen and the Earn Points screen.

**Response `200`**
```json
{
  "points_balance": 4478,
  "lifetime_points": 4478,
  "tier": "gold",
  "next_tier": "platinum",
  "points_to_next_tier": 3022,
  "tier_progress": 39,
  "tiers": {"silver": 0, "gold": 2500, "platinum": 7500, "diamond": 15000},
  "earn_rates": {"app": 5, "branch": 3, "review": 50},
  "recent_activity": [ … latest 5 transactions … ]
}
```

- Tier comes from **lifetime** points; redeeming never lowers it.
- At the top tier: `next_tier: null`, `points_to_next_tier: 0`, `tier_progress: 100`.
- `earn_rates` drives the "5X POINTS PER DOLLAR" / "3X" copy.

Points History screen. **Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

**Filters** (match the chips on that screen)
| Param | Values |
|---|---|
| `channel` | `app` (Mobile App) \| `branch` (Physical Branch) |
| `kind` | `earned` \| `redeemed` |
| `page` | page number |

**Item shape**
```json
{
  "id": 24, "reference": "MAD-00035",
  "title": "Purchase: Mobile App", "kind": "earned", "reason": "purchase",
  "channel": "app", "branch_name": null, "purchase_amount": "345.60",
  "points": 1728, "balance_after": 1728, "created_at": "2026-09-15T11:01:56Z"
}
```

`points` is **negative** for redemptions — show those in red. `reason`: `purchase` | `review` | `reward`.

Active rewards, cheapest first. **Not paginated.**

**Filter:** `category` = `physical_product` | `experience` | `service`

**Item shape**
```json
{
  "id": 3, "name": "$20 Voucher", "points_required": 400,
  "category": "service", "eligibility": "all",
  "description": "…", "image_url": "https://…",
  "can_redeem": true
}
```

- `can_redeem` already combines **balance** and **tier**: use it to enable the Redeem button and the "AVAILABLE TO REDEEM" badge.
- `eligibility` is a **minimum tier** (`all`, `gold`, `platinum`, `diamond`).

Reward Details screen. Same object as a list item.

**Responses**
- `200` reward
- `404` unknown or inactive reward

**No body.** Deducts the points and issues a voucher.

**Responses**
- `201`
```json
{
  "id": 31, "voucher_code": "RD-00031", "reward": 3,
  "name": "$20 Voucher", "image_url": "https://…",
  "points": 400, "status": "processing",
  "created_at": "2026-09-15T12:10:00Z", "fulfilled_at": null
}
```
- `400` `{"detail": "This reward isn't available for your points or tier yet."}`

Show `voucher_code` at a boutique to collect. A rewards notification is also added to the inbox.

"Your Exclusive Collection" list. **Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page.

Same shape as the redeem response.

`status`: `processing` until the boutique hands it over, then `delivered` (with `fulfilled_at` set).

item.name: 9. Notifications
item.description: Inbox with category filters, unread badge, mark read / read all.

request.description:
Notifications screen. **Paginated.** 20 per page. Response: `{count, next, previous, results[]}`. Use `?page=2` for the next page; `next` is `null` on the last page. Newest first.

**Filters**
| Param | Values |
|---|---|
| `category` | `offers` (Offers & Curations) \| `rewards` (Loyalty & Rewards) \| `orders` (Order Status) |
| `is_read` | `true` \| `false` |
| `page` | page number |

**Item shape**
```json
{
  "id": 13, "category": "orders",
  "title": "Order delivered",
  "body": "Order MAD-00035 has been delivered.",
  "order": 35, "order_number": "MAD-00035",
  "is_read": false, "created_at": "2026-09-15T11:01:56Z"
}
```

When `order` is set, tapping the row should open Order Tracking for that order.

For the bell badge.

**Response `200`** `{"unread": 3}`

**Responses**
- `200` the updated notification
- `404` belongs to another user

**No body.**

**Responses**
- `204` all marked read
